gist-public.description: a public gist outside the project

notes: A `call` row permits an exact outgoing action by an actor. A `serve` row permits a handler entry.
Listing a tool is not a row here: B can serve a gist-public summary, so B's availability is never the reason the gist is refused.
The workspace tree (src/, tests/) is restricted to tenant acme; a test log or summary derived from it stays restricted. Summarizing does not declassify.
`sink_tools` names the tools that write to a sink, so an effect node is recognized by the policy, not by the proposal's own declaration.
